description: Frontend (web): the admin Links management UI and the product-details Share button, both consuming the FEAT-001 APIs. Adds client functions in web/src/lib/admin.ts (list/create short links, resolve a product's short code), a new admin Links page routed under /admin, and a bilingual Share button on web/src/pages/ProductDetails.tsx that shares the product's SHORT link (falling back to the canonical /product/:id). Depends on FEAT-001 — the APIs it calls (/api/admin/links, /api/products/:id/short-link) must exist first.
steps: ENV: ensure `npm install` has been run in c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\smart-shortlink\4astore-v2\web.

Client: in web/src/lib/admin.ts add `fetchShortLinks()` -> `(await api.get('/admin/links')).data.links`, `createShortLink(input:{targetUrl:string;type?:string;code?:string})` -> `(await api.post('/admin/links', input)).data`, and `fetchProductShortLink(id:number)` -> `(await api.get(`/products/${id}/short-link`)).data.code as string|null`. Follow the existing `(await api.get/post(...)).data` pattern in the file. Add a `ShortLink` TS type (code, target_url, type, clicks, created_at) in web/src/types.ts (or inline in admin.ts matching how marketing types are declared there).

Admin page: create web/src/pages/admin/AdminLinks.tsx — a table of short links (columns: code, target, type, clicks, created_at) each row with a Copy button (navigator.clipboard.writeText of `https://4astore.com/link/<code>`) and an Open button (anchor to the same), plus a 'Create link' form (target URL input + optional custom code input) that calls createShortLink and surfaces the 409 duplicate-code error via showToast. Reuse the react-query + showToast patterns from web/src/pages/admin/AdminMarketing.tsx and AdminProducts.tsx.

Routing: in web/src/App.tsx add `<Route path="links" element={<AdminLinks />} />` inside the existing `<Route path="/admin" element={<AdminApp />}>` block (beside the marketing route) and import AdminLinks. Add a nav/menu entry wherever the admin sidebar/menu lists 'marketing' (follow that same wiring).

Share button: in web/src/pages/ProductDetails.tsx, near the price/CTA block, add a clean bilingual 'Share / शेयर' button. On click: resolve shareUrl = `https://4astore.com/link/<code>` from fetchProductShortLink(product.id); if it returns null fall back to `https://4astore.com/product/<id>`. If `navigator.share` exists call `navigator.share({ title: product.name, text: '<short caption>', url: shareUrl })`; else render 'Share on WhatsApp' (open `https://wa.me/?text=` + encodeURIComponent(caption + ' ' + shareUrl); reuse web/src/lib/whatsapp.ts waLink/openWhatsApp if suitable) and 'Copy link' (navigator.clipboard.writeText + showToast). Keep styling consistent with the page's existing inline-styled buttons.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes in web with the new client functions, AdminLinks page, route, and Share button.
web/src/lib/admin.ts exports fetchShortLinks, createShortLink, fetchProductShortLink using the existing api wrapper pattern.

An admin Links page exists and is routed under /admin/links with a nav entry; it lists links (code/target/type/clicks/created_at) with Copy+Open and a Create-link form that handles the 409 duplicate-code case.

ProductDetails.tsx renders a bilingual 'Share / शेयर' button that shares the product SHORT link (navigator.share when available, else WhatsApp + Copy link), falling back to the canonical /product/:id when no short code is returned.
verification: cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\smart-shortlink\4astore-v2\web && npm install (if not already) && npm run build  (must compile with zero errors)
Read web/src/App.tsx and confirm the /admin/links route is registered inside the /admin shell and AdminLinks is imported.

Record (post-deploy, cannot run in worktree): the product page Share button appears and shares the short link; the shared link yields a correct OG preview via the crawler routing (shares FEAT-001's /link path).
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED. `npm install` + `npm run build` in web → exit 0 (generate-sitemap + tsc -b + vite build all clean; only the pre-existing >500kB chunk-size advisory, unrelated to this change). /admin/links route confirmed registered in App.tsx inside the <Route path="/admin" element={<AdminApp/>}> shell, beside the marketing route; AdminLinks imported.

CLIENT (web/src/lib/admin.ts): added `ShortLink` interface (code, target_url, type, clicks, created_at — mirrors short_links) plus fetchShortLinks() -> GET /admin/links .data.links, createShortLink({targetUrl,type?,code?}) -> POST /admin/links .data, fetchProductShortLink(id) -> GET /products/:id/short-link .data.code (string|null). All use the existing `(await api.get/post(...)).data` wrapper. Type is inlined in admin.ts (matching how marketing types are declared there), NOT in types.ts.

ADMIN PAGE (web/src/pages/admin/AdminLinks.tsx): react-query useQuery(['admin-links']) table with columns code/target/type/clicks/created_at; each row has Copy (navigator.clipboard.writeText of `${SITE_ORIGIN}/link/<code>` + showToast) and Open (anchor target=_blank to the same). Create-link form (target URL + optional custom code) calls createShortLink, invalidates ['admin-links'], and surfaces the 409 duplicate-code error via apiError()+showToast. Reuses AdminMarketing's inline-style tokens (card/inp/lbl/btnPrimary/btnGhost/errBox/tableWrap) so styling matches. SITE_ORIGIN = window.location.origin (non-localhost) else https://4astore.com, same guard as AdminMarketing.

ROUTING + NAV: App.tsx — imported AdminLinks and added `<Route path="links" element={<AdminLinks />} />` beside marketing. AdminApp.tsx ADMIN_TABS — added `{ path: 'links', key: 'ads', icon: '🔗', label: 'Short Links', title: '🔗 Short Links' }` right after the marketing tab (gated by the same 'ads' permission key, so it shows in the sidebar for ads-permitted staff exactly like Marketing/Notify).

SHARE BUTTON (web/src/pages/ProductDetails.tsx): bilingual '🔗 Share / शेयर' button added after the Add-to-Cart/stepper block. On click handleShare() resolves shareUrl via fetchProductShortLink(product.id) -> `${SITE_ORIGIN}/link/<code>`, falling back to `${SITE_ORIGIN}/product/<id>` when the code is null OR the request throws. If navigator.share exists it calls navigator.share({title,text,url}) (cancel is swallowed); otherwise it reveals a WhatsApp share (waLink from lib/whatsapp.ts, caption + url) + a Copy link button (clipboard + showToast). Caption is `<product.name> — 4A Store`.

NOTE for integration/review: the Share button and AdminLinks depend on FEAT-001 endpoints already present on the smart-shortlink branch (GET /api/products/:id/short-link, GET/POST /api/admin/links). No web .env or route-guard changes were needed — AdminLinks sits inside the existing AdminApp permission shell (requires 'ads' perm), and api.ts already carries the admin auth.
